cell_type_annotation.description:
Label each cluster with a cell-identity from marker-gene panels or reference
mapping (CellTypist / SingleR / Azimuth / sctype). ecaax namespace per the
EDAM audit — operation:0361 (sequence annotation) is a semantic mismatch
for cell-identity calling on count matrices.

attributes.claim_boundary:
Cell-type calls are statistical assignments, not pathology. Report the
reference / panel / marker set used alongside every label. Do not infer
functional state from identity alone.

contextualize_findings_with_literature.description:
Map each row of the upstream findings table (DE genes / called peaks /
called variants) to PMID-anchored prior-work rows. Emit
claims_evidence_matrix.csv with deterministic concordance flags
(same_direction / opposite_direction / no_prior_finding / unverifiable).
No synthesis; no narrative.

attributes.claim_boundary:
This atom emits row-level concordance flags ONLY. Each row references one
upstream finding (finding_id), zero or more prior PMIDs, and a closed-set
concordance flag whose semantics are: same_direction iff the prior's effect
direction matches the analysis effect direction AND both effect-size
magnitudes are >0; opposite_direction iff signs differ; no_prior_finding
iff zero prior rows for this entity in this tissue; unverifiable iff prior
rows exist but their evidence_quote does not specify a direction. Do NOT
introduce composite or narrative claims. Do NOT generate paragraphs that
the upstream atom did not also generate row-wise.

EVIDENCE GATING (MANDATORY; enforced by post-task validation): cite a prior
PMID — and assert same_direction / opposite_direction / unverifiable — ONLY
for a PMID that has a DOWNLOADED evidence snapshot you can point to (a
snapshots/<sha256> file recorded in an evidence/manifest.json, either this
task's own or an upstream literature task's such as review_prior_work /
survey_method_landscape). Before writing ANY PMID into
claims_evidence_matrix.csv, confirm it resolves to such a manifest entry; if it
does not, DROP the citation and set that row to no_prior_finding (leave the
prior PMID column empty). NEVER cite a PMID from memory, from the finding's
gene/region/variant name, or one you have not actually retrieved — an
unretrieved PMID is an unsupported claim and will block the workflow. Record
every PMID you DO cite as an entry in THIS task's evidence/manifest.json
(reuse the upstream snapshot path) so downstream validation resolves it.

Gene-identity rule (MANDATORY): gene symbols MUST be resolved to Ensembl IDs
using the run's pinned genome annotation (org.Hs.eg.db / biomaRt at the
package's Ensembl release), OR by joining on the Ensembl IDs already present
in the upstream differential-expression table (de_results.tsv gene_id column).
You MUST NOT hardcode Ensembl IDs and you MUST NOT recall them from memory; do
not embed a literal symbol→Ensembl map in the script. You MUST NOT fall back to
a literal ID when a lookup fails — on lookup failure, mark the gene unresolved
rather than guessing. Resolution goes through the pinned annotation/adapter or
the upstream table only. Every emitted finding_id must be an Ensembl ID that
appears in the upstream DE table or is explicitly flagged absent. For every
gene row, ALSO populate the `entity` column with that gene's HGNC symbol (and
entity_kind = gene), carried straight from the same annotation join used for
the Ensembl id — so the independent gene-symbol↔Ensembl consistency check can
confirm the citation is attached to the right gene.

data_acquisition.description:
Acquire raw experimental data from public repositories (SRA, GEO, ArrayExpress,
ENA, PRIDE, ClinVar, gnomAD, GTEx) or SME-supplied paths. Emits a cohort manifest,
per-accession provenance summary, and an index pointing at the materialized
artifacts. Downstream atoms consume the manifest, not the raw bytes directly.

differential_expression.description:
Test for differentially expressed genes between conditions / cell types.
DESeq2 / edgeR / limma-voom / MAST / Wilcoxon selected at runtime based on
modality (bulk vs single-cell) and design.

RECORD-WHAT-YOU-DID (audit, not instruction): in result.json, write down the
model you actually fit so it can be audited — this does NOT tell you which
model/test to use, only to state your own choice. Record:
  - design_formula: the model formula you fit (e.g. "~ condition + sex + RIN").
  - response_variable: the model's outcome / left-hand side (the thing being
    explained). For a contrast-based DE this is the expression/count response;
    for a regression against an outcome it is that outcome variable.
  - available_covariates: the covariate columns you observed in the sample
    metadata (your honest list of what was available, e.g.
    ["condition","sex","age","RIN"]).
  - primary_variable: the main comparison variable for the contrast (e.g.
    "condition").
  - stated_outcome: the SME's stated outcome for the task, when the task names
    one (otherwise omit).
These are YOUR record of YOUR choices and of the data/task — a domain-correctness
contract checks them for internal + task consistency (e.g. the design adjusts
for an available covariate; the response matches the stated outcome). It never
prescribes a model.

attributes.claim_boundary:
Differential expression is statistical association, not biological causation.
Report effect-size + adjusted p-value + the reference factor level for every
contrast. Avoid mechanistic language; prefer "associated with" / "enriched in"
over "drives" / "causes".

dimensionality_reduction.description:
Project the (normalised, batch-corrected) feature matrix to a low-dimensional
embedding for visualization and clustering. PCA followed by UMAP or t-SNE is
the default; method choice deferred to runtime.

discover_cell_type_annotation.description: Discover method for cell_type_annotation (options: celltypist, singler, azimuth, sctype, marker_panel). Surface set_intake_method.

discover_differential_expression.description: Discover method for differential_expression (options: deseq2, edger, limma_voom, mast, wilcoxon). Surface set_intake_method.

discover_dimensionality_reduction.description: Discover method for dimensionality_reduction (options: pca, umap, tsne, phate). Surface set_intake_method.

discover_normalisation.description: Discover method for normalisation (options: deseq2_vst, edger_tmm, scran, seurat_lognormalize, sctransform). Surface set_intake_method.

discover_spatial_clustering_method.description: Discover method for spatial_clustering_method (options: banksy, bayesspace, squidpy_neighbors, graphst). Surface set_intake_method.

final_reporting.description:
Assemble the project-level final report: cross-stage narrative, dashboard
index, key figures, methods + caveats. Final node before SME review.

attributes.claim_boundary:
Findings-first: lead with the validated result rows and the
biological_interpretation narrative (when present), then methods and
caveats. Restate findings exactly as produced by upstream validated
tasks — every claim traces to an emitted result row or to an
interpretation statement that itself cites one. Do not introduce
claims that aren't backed by an emitted artifact; do not soften or
strengthen effect-size language; do not recommend methods the
pipeline did not run.

This report is the read-and-evaluated deliverable, so carry the upstream
substance FORWARD into it rather than collapsing to a thin digest: the
findings, their interpretation, and the data/source grounding the
upstream tasks already recorded must appear in the report itself, not be
left behind in per-task outputs or the trace. This is faithful
re-emission under the trace-to-artifact rule above — NOT license to pad
with generic prose, and NOT license to add any finding, theme, value, or
citation that no upstream artifact produced (an unsupported addition is a
fabrication, worse than an omission). Generic reporting discipline only;
do not tailor content to any external grading rubric.

normalisation.description:
Standardise expression values to remove library-size and composition biases.
Method neutrality: DESeq2 VST / edgeR TMM / scran pooling / Seurat
LogNormalize / scnorm / sctransform are selected at runtime.

qc_preprocessing.description:
Apply count-matrix-level QC: cell or sample filtering by total counts, gene
detection, mitochondrial fraction, and doublet score. Distinct from `raw_qc`
(which operates on raw reads). ecaax:scrnaseq_cell_qc per the EDAM audit —
EDAM operation:3218 conflates raw-read QC with count-matrix QC.

reporting.description:
Assemble narrative tables, figures, and summary text from upstream stage
outputs into a per-stage HTML / Markdown report. Modality-agnostic; bio
taxonomies override the description at the include site to specify what
goes into the report.

review_prior_work.description:
Retrieve prior literature (PMC OA full-text XML by default, broader via
ECAA_LIT_SOURCE_SCOPE) on the analysis's target entities + tissue +
modality. Emit a structured prior_claims_matrix.csv where every row is
PMID-anchored with a substring-verified evidence_quote. No biological
synthesis, no narrative review.

attributes.claim_boundary:
Every row in prior_claims_matrix.csv is a verbatim quote from one PMID's
available source text (PMC OA full-text XML, abstract, or — under explicit
scope — a locally-fetched PDF). Do NOT paraphrase, summarize, or synthesize
across PMIDs. Do NOT assert biological fact, mechanism, or causation. Do NOT
assert whether the prior work agrees or disagrees with anything — that is
the downstream contextualization atom's role, and even there it is row-wise
mechanical, not narrative. Rows whose evidence_quote does not exactly
substring-match the retrieved source are emitted with verified=false and
surface as BlockerKind::ValidationFailed { LiteratureClaim }.

spatial_domain_segmentation.description:
Segment a spatial-transcriptomics tissue section into regions of similar
expression profile. Method choice deferred to discover_* (BANKSY, BayesSpace,
Squidpy spatial neighbors, GraphST). Emits per-spot region label + adjacency
graph that downstream neighborhood-enrichment stages consume.
ecaax:spatial_clustering — EDAM clusters at operation:3432 but spatial
modality has additional graph-aware constraints.

spatially_variable_genes.description:
Identify genes whose expression varies systematically across spatial
coordinates beyond what cell-type abundance alone explains. Methods:
Moran's I, SpatialDE, SOMDE, Spark-X. Emits a ranked table of genes
with spatial-variability statistic + adjusted p-value. ecaax:spatially_
variable_genes — extends EDAM operation:3223 (DE) into the spatial
axis the upstream ontology doesn't model.

survey_method_landscape.description:
Retrieve a context-scoped METHOD-LANDSCAPE for this analysis: for each
runtime method-choice axis in the workflow, gather candidate methods and
PMID/DOI/URL-anchored evidence, conditioned on the specific data
(organism, protocol, sample count, missingness from the upstream QC +
sample-manifest) and the analysis goal/modality. When the task carries
an attributes.goal_context (the SME analysis goal), treat it as RETRIEVAL
SCOPE — gather candidate methods + evidence relevant to that goal (e.g. a
low-allele-frequency / heteroplasmy detection goal widens retrieval toward
AF-window-aware candidates). This conditions WHAT is retrieved only; it is
never a ranking or recommendation instruction. Honors
config/downstream-policy/source-discovery-policy.json. Emit a
method_landscape.csv where every row is locator-anchored with a
substring-verified evidence_quote. No synthesis; no ranking (the
discover_* atoms rank deterministically from this table).

attributes.claim_boundary:
Every row in method_landscape.csv is a verbatim quote from one resolvable
source (PMID/DOI/URL), with its locator, source_class, and evidence_role.
Do NOT rank, recommend, paraphrase, or synthesize. Ranking is the
downstream discover_* atom's deterministic job. Rows whose evidence_quote
does not substring-match the retrieved snapshot are emitted verified=false.
